description:
Spec IN-12 + IN-16 in the Library UI: a clip whose file was
deleted or moved (Access.GONE, commit b287f72) now shows a
distinct 'File missing' row with a Re-link action, and the
re-link runs through the SAF picker with the fingerprint check
from the repository layer - a match rebinds the same id (grade,
gyro, stats and exports all survive), a mismatch is the honest
error and changes nothing.

Row state: LibraryRowModel.rowStatus is the pure Access-to-state
mapping (LOST / GONE / null-healthy). The row renders through the
shared FileListRow's degraded slots with DISTINCT strings per
state - 'Access lost' + 'Grant access' for a revoked permission,
'File missing' + 'Re-link' for a deleted/moved document - so the
two recoveries stay visually separate without touching the shared
component. An unexpected future Access value maps to a healthy
